tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, dialogs, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: table headers, read-only fields, the sidebar.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card edges (decorative only, not for control borders).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders; 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels and metadata, on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Brand colour: primary actions, links, active navigation, focus ring; as text, on the surfaces or brand-soft.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill (the primary button label).

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind brand text: selected rows, active nav item, approved state.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Deep ink for the brand mark and large brand blocks; on surface only.

tokens.name: kina-gold
tokens.usage: Accent for money highlights: amount due today, the borrower's next payment; as text, on the surfaces or kina-gold-soft.

tokens.name: kina-gold-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind kina-gold text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Repaid, on time, APPROVE recommendation. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind success text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Arrears 1-30 days, REFER recommendation, pending actions. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind warning text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Arrears over 30 days, DECLINE, write-off, destructive actions. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind danger text.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Submitted / pending approval, neutral notices.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind info text.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring offset 2px; alias of brand (>=3:1 on every surface in both themes).

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Fraunces, used sparingly: page titles and the borrower's headline balance.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles and one hero figure per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles in the staff app.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: IBM Plex Sans for everything people read and operate.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Monthly income is verified against three payslips.
styles.usage: Default text, form inputs, table cells.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Eyebrows and metadata; uppercase only for short labels.

groups.name: Figures
groups.note: IBM Plex Mono for account numbers and references; money uses Plex Sans with tabular figures.

styles.name: reference
styles.usage: Loan and client numbers, receipt and bank references.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Pill padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Field stacks, table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Pills, badges, table rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Cards on surface; dialogs use line + this, never heavier.
